ratings.comment: Lectures were incredible and very in-depth. The class, online summer 2020, had a lot of work in the four weeks, often I did 6+ hours of lectures and note taking Tests were fair, the q's were taken from the practice questions at the end of each lecture and the readings that the essay q's were based on were interesting He knows a lot and teaches well

There's a reason he sends students a disclaimer a week before class begins. Read it. If you think he's kidding - he's not. If you can't commit, drop. This course maintains a HEAVY load. At a min. 3 hours of reading/lectures per day. Only 2 grades: midterm and final. The lectures are pull your hair out boring but the content is interesting.

I took his summer class and it is a lot of work. However, this class made me a better writer and the material is quite interesting. I applaud him for fitting so much info into 3 weeks plus adding a lot of info on Asian immigration where most classes disregard that region!

Great class. Although most of the material relating to immigration was from the European standpoint and African Americans during the Civil Rights Movement. Of course they are pertinent to the class but would have liked to see more! Very interesting topic, and fairly graded by Nick Strohl.
Great professor. The class is graded fairly and not too much work. He is funny and interesting to listen to.

He gives you all of the questions for both multiple choice and essay parts of the exam beforehand, and you can use your notes. Impossible not to get an A if you put in the smallest amount of effort. Really interesting material, too!
This guy is awesome!  Very interesting course and not a hard grader, he just wants you to learn the material.

He is seriously so cool for being old! Class was so easy. Some readings each week and two papers plus a final research paper. He ripped my papers apart, but I still got an A. Had some weird expectations for papers, but overall made me a better writer. If you like history or immigration, take a class with Archdeacon!

online course is very reading-intensive, obviously. however, you will learn LOTS & the material is very interesting and some even relevant to the present day. take this class if you love cultures and exploring historical events! archdeacon is so informed and kind with grading scale.
His purpose in life is to make you understand the material unfortunatly he easily get off topic and becomes hard to understand what he wants from you.

Professor Archdeacon is awesome. He genuinely cares about his students and wants them to do well. Reading assignments can get long but there are no exams. Extremely helpful and responsive to students needs. I would definitely take another class with him. Plus, he buys his students pizza when we watch movies!

Having an online course is tough just in that you have to actually be committed to watching HOURS of lecture every week in your free time, but Archdeacon was helpful, clear, and his tests were kind of fun/creative.  I'd highly recommend if you've an intrest in immigration b/c he is very knowledgable.Also, he holds online review sessions, which rock
Very nice and intelligent man.  Has some quirks, but I enjoyed his class.  He made a 2.5 hour seminar survivable.  I would take another class with him again!

Presents a lot of information, now that the class is online.  His pronunciation of most words is TERRIBLE, which gets pretty annoying.  His tone is also very slow and boring.  He sounds like the hypnotist in Office Space, like his is about to die.
He seems to be off in space a lot.  He says "boot" instead of "But" which does get a little annoying
